$comment: Generated from pipeline/snowlight/schemas by `uv run python -m snowlight.schemas`. Do not edit.

ContentDigest.description: A SHA-256 digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

DayTally.description: How many days of a school year one school had a status.

DirectoryStamp.description:
The directory a file's school and district indexes point into.

It must equal generated_on, count and the number of districts of the
schools/meta.json the reader has loaded; otherwise the file is ignored.
DirectoryStamp.title: DirectoryStamp

LocalDate.description: A calendar day in the school's own time zone: YYYY-MM-DD.

SchemaVersion.description: The file format's version. A reader refuses a file with any other.

SchoolGap.description: A school index written as its distance from the one before it: index = previous index + 1 + gap, and the first previous index is -1. So [4, 0, 2] is schools 4, 5 and 8.

SchoolYear.description: A school year, July to June, as YYYY-YYYY (2026-2027).

description:
live/season.json: each school's closed, delayed, remote and early-dismissal days this
school year.

Counted from the final day timelines (``live/days/<day>.json`` with ``final`` true) of
every day from ``since`` through ``through``: each school is counted once a day, under
the status its timeline ended the day on; a status taken back by then counts nowhere.
One row per school with at least one such day, in school order: ``gaps`` as in
closings.json, and ``closed[i]``, ``delayed[i]``, ``remote[i]`` and
``early_dismissal[i]`` are the i-th school's days.

content_sha256.description: The content digest of the directory edition the school indexes point into (as the day timelines'); null for an emptied file.

gaps.description: Each school, as a gap from the previous school's index.

since.description: The first day counted: the school year's first day (July 1), or the later day counting began.

through.description: The last day counted, the last day over everywhere.

title: SeasonFile
